examples.translation: Bishops claim the name of whichever color they land in first, color which is kept until the end.

examples.english: Two white bishops, usually represented by the symbol: […] The bishop can be moved to any square along the diagonals upon which it is found.

examples.text: Dos alfiles blancos, representados habitualmente por el símbolo: […] El alfil puede ser movido a cualquier casilla a lo largo de una de las diagonales sobre las que se encuentra.
